blurb: Provides fire safety information including smoke and carbon monoxide alarms, fire permits for open air burning and fireworks, and emergency preparedness guidance. Offers resources for home fire safety, false alarm prevention, and emergency planning. Manages fire bans and enforces fire safety regulations in the Township of Muskoka Lakes.
extraNote: Burn permits non-transferable and suspended during fire bans or in restricted fire zones · Fire Chief may revoke permits or order extinguishing of fires if by-law provisions not followed · Fees for false fire alarms: $570.50 per apparatus per hour · Fire bans declared when atmospheric or local conditions make fires hazardous
